[[Fable Reef]] |Season = {{Season|All}} |Sell Price = {{Price|150}} |dsvprice = 150 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Forage|forageable]] item that can be obtained by foraging at [[Stardew:The Beach|The Beach]] or [[Fable Reef]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Gifting== Conch is a '''universally neutral''' gift, with the following exceptions. {{Gifting |love= Sandy |like= Elliott, Evelyn, Gunther, Haley, Jas, Vincent, Willy }} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|orange}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces an orange color. {{PAGENAME}} can be used in the spool of the [[Stardew:2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Stardew:Tailoring|Strapped Top]]. ==History== {{Navbox Forage}} [[Category:Forage]] [[zh:海螺]]
